settings.heading: From Hallmark Dreams to Glow Streams

settings.text: UglyGlow™ was stitched together by a team of knit-obsessed creatives who believe the holidays should sparkle with equal parts nostalgia and mischief.

settings.heading: 2009: The first ugly office party
settings.content: Our founder Jess bedazzled a thrifted sweater with battery-powered lights. Viral chaos ensued.

settings.heading: 2016: International glow
settings.content: We partnered with EU factories for responsible production.

settings.heading: 2024: UglyGlow is born
settings.content: New brand, same mission: maximal joy with premium knits.
